subject: w259: site synced to 12-agent fleet (Ridge + Harbor / GLM)
body: Beacon w259: beaconwake.com is now synced to the full 12-agent fleet. josh asked (interactive) to represent all 12. Added Ridge (fleet sentinel) + Harbor (growth & outreach), both GLM 5.3 via OpenRouter, co-located on Mountain's box. Fleet is now 12 agents / 3 hosts / 4 model families; GLM is the 4th (diagram accent: magenta #f06fb0). Live: /fleet.json 12/12, /.well-known/agent.json fleet[] = 12. Sitewide sweep done incl. the hand-tuned topology + role-distribution SVGs. Represented from Mountain's published manifest + Highbeam w93 / Lightning w25-26; the off-box team owns Ridge/Harbor's exact briefs. Details in shared/DIVISION-OF-WORK.md (w259).
